jobs.description: Location: San Francisco or Singapore (on-site), or remote (Singapore or US Pacific time zones) Start Date: ASAP Languages: English Team: Engineering About the Role Our client is a fast-growing AI company building reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI training data. It is already used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs, and the company is backed by leading venture investors, including Y Combinator. They are scaling quickly to meet strong demand. We are looking for a Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization to build the systems that make sensitive, real-world data safe and still useful for AI training. You will develop methods to detect and remove personally identifiable information, secrets and other sensitive content from raw data before it enters processing and synthetic data pipelines â protecting privacy without destroying the structure and signal that make the data valuable for training agents. This is a privacy and data-protection engineering seat, not a synthetic-task design role. You will own the pipeline that stands in front of downstream processing, training, evaluation and synthetic generation. This is a full-time role, starting ASAP. Offices are in San Francisco and Singapore; remote candidates are welcome if their working hours can overlap about 70â80% with either San Francisco (US Pacific) or Singapore business hours. Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it enters downstream processing, training, evaluation or synthetic data generation. Create evaluation frameworks that measure privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests and adversarial re-identification attempts. An understanding of the difference between redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization and synthetic data â and when each is appropriate. High attention to detail, and the ability to reason about subtle leakage paths, edge cases and adversarial failure modes. Experience building data-processing pipelines end to end, including where there was no fully prescribed roadmap. Clear written and spoken English, and comfort collaborating across teams and time zones. jobs.description: About us At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. The role Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer. You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients. You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. You will work closely with the team that builds Scribble, and you will own the workflow experience it works through, so that a workflow behaves the same whether a person or an agent is driving it. When that works, building a workflow stops being a specialist job. Key responsibilities Own the charter for Workflows and Integrations: the durable problem, success metrics, and an explicit in and out scope list. Grow adoption across every customer, measured by the number of workflows built and run and the number of people building them. Make building a workflow simple enough for a marketer or creative to do without help, through templates, guided set-up and defaults that cover the common jobs. Own the workflow experience that Scribble works through, so that an agent can find, build, change and run a workflow with the same tools a person uses. Make human review part of the run: a workflow should pause for a person's decision, record it, and continue down the right path. Make runs dependable at volume, with scheduling, run management, failure handling and clear status, so that a team trusts a workflow to run unattended. Own third-party integrations outside media, from digital asset management and file storage to translation and data services, and make them built-in steps in a workflow, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. Set the integration framework and standards that client teams build on when they connect a system for a single client. Work with customers to find the jobs they repeat every week and turn them into workflows and templates that others can reuse. Run the full lifecycle from discovery to post-launch review, with a written hypothesis before every ship and a review against it afterwards. Use product data and structured customer feedback to set priorities, working backwards from evidenced customer need. Partner closely with design on the builder experience, and with engineering on run reliability and the integration framework. jobs.description: Software Engineer, Infrastructure Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) Â· $185Kâ$215K base + meaningful early-stage equity + full benefits Â About Sodalis Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait. Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist. We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx). Â The Opportunity Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own. We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live. We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range. You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture. What you'll do Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between. Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy. Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site. Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range. Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture. What we're looking for 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering. You've taken an AWS-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services. You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded. You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them. You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity. You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required. How we work We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer Case Execution
jobs.description: About Pivotal Health Pivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape. Today, many providers face persistent underpayment from health insurance companies, despite delivering high-quality care. While processes like IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) were designed to promote fairness, theyâre often administrative-heavy, time-consuming, and difficult to navigate without the right tools. Pivotal Health combines software, data, and service into a seamlessly integrated, AI-driven platform that simplifies these complex reimbursement workflows. We help providers efficiently dispute underpaid claims, reduce administrative burden, and recover the reimbursement theyâre entitled to; without adding more work to already stretched teams. Our full-service IDR solution is just the starting point. Weâre building solutions that enable providers to operate with clarity, control, and confidence across the reimbursement journey. About the Role We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join Pivotal's Case Execution team. This team owns critical parts of the case execution workflow, including eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These systems sit at the operational core of how Pivotal delivers outcomes for providers. This is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys solving complex, workflow-driven backend problems and working through data-heavy decision logic. The most technically demanding areas for this team are eligibility and batching, and the right person is energized by that kind of work rather than looking to avoid it. What You'll Do Build and improve core case execution systems: Own backend development across eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These are the systems that determine how cases move through Pivotal's platform and reach resolution. Tackle complex, data-driven backend problems: Work through the decision logic and data-heavy workflows that make eligibility and batching hard, understanding not just how individual systems work, but how they interact across the broader platform. Contribute to workflow orchestration: Build and improve the systems that coordinate how cases are staged, routed, and executed end to end, with a clear eye toward correctness and reliability. Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with the Integrations team, Case Strategy team, and other engineering and product partners to ensure systems are well-connected and aligned with how the broader platform operates. Contribute to front-end and admin workflows where needed: The role is primarily backend-focused, but you'll contribute to internal-facing UI and ops tooling where the product requires it. Who You Are 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong backend focus Strong engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building data-heavy, workflow-oriented systems Experience working on complex, data-driven decision logic or orchestration problems: you're comfortable with systems where correctness and sequencing both matter Comfortable operating in a collaborative, fast-moving startup environment where ownership and requirements evolve Python experience; able to work effectively in a Python-based backend environment Self-directed and proactive: you identify problems and drive them to resolution without heavy oversight Strong communicator who collaborates well across engineering, product, and adjacent teams Extra Credit If You Have Experience with healthcare-specific data or HealthTech systems Exposure to data-heavy architectures or problems adjacent to data engineering without being a pure data engineer Familiarity with tools like Snowflake, dbt, or Databricks Some front-end experience to support admin workflow contributions Why Youâll Love Working Here Weâre a collaborative, low-ego team on a mission to make healthcare reimbursement fairer for providers. jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it. This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges. We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved. What you'll be doing Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against. Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery. Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back. Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness. Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record. Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears. Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation. What you'll need Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers. Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify. Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

jobs.title: Entrepreneur in Residence
jobs.description: About Act There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting. About the Role We are looking for an Entrepreneur in Residence to help achieve our mission. You will work directly with founders and senior leaders on high-priority initiatives across hiring, market expansion, partnerships, operations, and growth. This role is for highly capable generalists who enjoy solving problems, moving quickly, and taking ownership. We are looking for people who can turn ideas into execution and create meaningful impact from day one. What You Will Be Doing Drive high-priority projects across hiring, operations, growth, and market expansion. Build relationships with candidates, recruiters, universities, communities, and external partners. Support new market launches and expansion initiatives. Help identify opportunities and solve operational challenges. Represent ActAI at events, communities, and external engagements. Work closely with founders on strategic initiatives. Take ownership of projects from concept through execution. What You Will Need Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities. Excellent communication and relationship-building skills. Ability to operate independently with limited structure. Strong execution skills and bias toward action. High ownership and willingness to take on unfamiliar challenges. Comfortable working across multiple functions and disciplines. Strong alignment with ActAI's mission and ambition. How We Work The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams. We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions. This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success. Interview Process If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews. Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite. We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process. jobs.description: Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Chipindustrie – von Anfang an! Deine Rolle bei Black Semiconductor Bei Black Semiconductor entwickeln wir eine neue Generation der Halbleitertechnologie. Mit unserer ersten Produktionsanlage FabOne in Aachen schaffen wir die Grundlage für die Chipfertigung der Zukunft. Dafür suchen wir dich! Als Elektriker*in wirst du Teil unseres Facility-Teams und unterstützt den Aufbau, die Inbetriebnahme und den Betrieb der elektrotechnischen Infrastruktur unserer Produktionsanlage. Über uns Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen. Wir laden Dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Deinem Wissen und Deinen Fähigkeiten kannst Du beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können. Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist. Unsere Technology Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz. Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau. Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie. Deine Aufgaben Aufbau, Installation und Inbetriebnahme der elektrotechnischen Infrastruktur unserer Produktionsanlage. Wartung, Prüfung und Instandhaltung elektrischer Anlagen und Niederspannungssysteme. Fehlersuche und Störungsbehebung an elektrischen Installationen und Steuerstromkreisen. Lesen und Interpretieren von Stromlauf-, Schalt- und Verdrahtungsplänen. Mitarbeit bei der Inbetriebnahme und Weiterentwicklung unserer Gebäudeautomation (FMCS), einschließlich Steuerungs- und Visualisierungssystemen. Koordination und Unterstützung externer Elektrofachfirmen sowie Sicherstellung einer fachgerechten und sicheren Ausführung. Unterstützung bei elektrischen Prüfungen, technischer Dokumentation und Materialbeschaffung. Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektroniker für Betriebstechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Energie- und Gebäudetechnik oder eine vergleichbare elektrotechnische Qualifikation. Praktische Erfahrung in der Elektroinstallation, Instandhaltung oder Betriebstechnik. Gute Kenntnisse in der Elektrotechnik und Freude an praktischer Fehlersuche und Problemlösung. Sicherer Umgang mit Stromlauf- und Schaltplänen. Grundkenntnisse der relevanten elektrotechnischen Vorschriften und Sicherheitsbestimmungen. Eine selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team. Sehr Gute Deutschkenntnisse; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil. jobs.title: Senior CRM & Lifecycle Manager
jobs.description: Your mission Cosuno is a platform for construction tendering in the German-speaking market. It connects general contractors, who publish bid packages, with subcontractors, who bid on them, and both sides pay. As our Senior Lifecycle & Customer Growth Manager, you own how customers on both sides activate, buy and stay. You decide which signals matter and what should happen next, and a Growth Engineer builds the system with you. You'll be one of the first hires in a lean marketing team and shape how it works as it grows. We're looking for someone ambitious: you think in systems that sense, decide and learn, not in a handful of fixed, old-school email journeys. What you'll do • Define the lifecycle and signal strategy for general contractors and subcontractors: the key stages and behaviours, and the signals that predict activation, repeat usage, expansion or churn. • Turn those signals into playbooks: prioritized interventions, segments and messages, coordinated with Sales and Customer Success where a human touch works better. • Drive subcontractor activation, conversion to Premium and churn prevention, and contractor adoption and retention, including 1:1 logic on enriched account data. • Prove what works with cohort baselines, A/B tests and holdout groups, so decisions rest on incremental impact, not campaign output. • Build a signal-driven system with the Growth Engineer that decides what happens next, starting from a prioritized signal-to-action map. • Later, build retention and referral programmes and help hire a second Lifecycle Manager. What you bring • You've owned lifecycle, CRM, retention or growth programmes and can show their commercial impact, ideally in B2B SaaS or a two-sided business. • You're ambitious and think big: you design lifecycle as a system that adapts to each customer, not as a set of fixed drip journeys that get tweaked once a quarter. • You're data-driven: you've moved activation, conversion or retention metrics and you read experiment results critically. • You're technically fluent: you've worked with an engineer on a complex system with solid tracking and solved problems from the implementation side. • You're AI-native: you've built AI-driven automation into a real journey, not only used AI to write copy faster. • You get things done, learn fast and are comfortable building from scratch. • You work well across Product, Sales, Customer Success and Engineering. • Fluent English; German is a big plus. Experience with ActiveCampaign or Salesforce is a plus. Your benefits • Room to shape and grow: one of the first marketing hires, with real ownership of lifecycle and CRM on both sides of the platform. • AI at the core: our product uses AI to analyze millions of price data points and help construction companies bid better, and we invest in it just as much internally. You'll build with the latest tools and move fast. • Competitive compensation: salary above market average, permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company. • Work-life balance: fully remote or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg, flexible hours. • Top-notch equipment: a new MacBook Pro. • A great team: open, international, with regular off-sites and team events. • Growth and feedback: open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations. About us Cosuno is a fast-growing tech company making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with its digital platform for tenders and procurement. Our goal: to solve the industry's most complex challenges with innovation and simplicity. Join us and build the future of construction. Compensation: €65K – €85K • €65K – €85K Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description: Your mission We're a small data team with a big job: helping everyone at Cosuno make better decisions. Our data platform is stable and in good hands. What we need now is someone who takes our most important, open-ended business questions and answers them properly: in depth, with little guidance, and often before anyone thought to ask. You'll work across product and commercial topics. How do general contractors and subcontractors actually use our platform? What makes some accounts grow into company-wide rollouts? Map how our customers really use the product: which workflows stick, where new features find their audience, and what healthy adoption looks like in an account's first months. Pick a question nobody has asked yet, answer it, and change a product or go-to-market decision with the result. Build the dbt models and Looker views your analyses need, so the next person can answer the question themselves. How we work Questions Over Tickets: You don't wait for requests. Your profile 5+ years in analytics at fast-growing startups or scaleups, ideally B2B SaaS, where your work shaped product or commercial decisions. Hands-on experience in both product analytics (usage, adoption, engagement, experimentation) and commercial analytics (retention, expansion, funnel, pricing). A track record of driving your own analytical agenda with minimal guidance. Strong SQL and professional experience with dbt and a BI tool (a strong command of Looker is a big plus). Strong, hands-on familiarity with AI tools, especially Claude Code, and a habit of using them in your daily work. Excellent written and spoken English. You can explain a complex finding in one clear paragraph. Bonus Experience with marketplaces or two-sided platforms. Experience in vertical SaaS, construction tech or procurement. jobs.description: Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that builds trust, sparks innovation, and strengthens team culture. About Superhuman Superhuman is an AI productivity suite that makes AI work for everyone. Over 40 million people rely on it daily to get work done. A recognized leader in productivity tools, Superhuman is the maker of popular products including Docs, Fathom, Go, GPTZero, Grammarly, and Mail. The newest product, Superhuman Go, builds on Grammarly’s ability to deliver help everywhere people work. It lets anyone build proactive agents that act as teammates across more than 1 million apps and websites, without changing how they work. Learn more at superhuman.com . The Opportunity We're looking for a Security Engineer to join our Detection & Response Team to achieve our ambitious goals. This role will contribute to our D&R team as hands-on practitioner across incident response, detection engineering, threat hunting, and threat intelligence. You'll plan, execute, and debrief complex security operations, leveraging those insights to enhance our threat mitigation capabilities and build robust, automated security tooling across all Superhuman environments. Additionally, you'll own key workstreams in executing and advancing our security vision, translating strategic objectives into tactical implementations through strong technical execution and innovative solution building, with particular emphasis on automation and AI-powered security solutions. You'll conduct research across security domains and automation technologies, identifying opportunities to enhance our capabilities through cutting-edge approaches and intelligent automation. Finally, you'll bring an attacker mindset into Superhuman’s engineering and security culture, thinking like a threat actor to defend our systems in a way that is grounded in how real attacks happen. Superhuman's engineers and researchers have the freedom to innovate and uncover breakthroughs—and, in turn, influence our product roadmap. The complexity of our technical challenges is growing rapidly as we scale our interfaces, algorithms, and infrastructure. Curious how we build and operate our AI agents? Check out our engineering blog , and explore our threat-hunting AI here . As a Security Engineer, you will: Own the IR strategy end-to-end, building, maintaining, and operating the systems and tooling that strengthen our ability to detect, contain, and recover from security incidents at scale Build and maintain automated threat detection systems, AI-driven alert triage solutions, and security intelligence pipelines that scale with business growth Conduct threat hunting and detection engineering, developing detection-as-code, hunting-as-code, and intelligence-as-code capabilities. Research and develop cutting-edge security automation and AI-powered security solutions to deepen and scale our ability to identify threats, including autonomous security agents. Operate without traditional scope limitations, following attacker kill chains to uncover security gaps that scoped teams miss. Lead complex security investigations, including insider threat scenarios and sophisticated attack campaigns. Maintain incident response capabilities and serve as part of the Incident Command on-call schedule. Embed attacker mindset thinking throughout the organization through education and collaboration with engineering teams. Qualifications Has 3+ years of relevant experience in security engineering, with expertise across multiple disciplines including incident response and detection engineering (threat intelligence, threat hunting experience is nice to have too) Proven incident response leadership and complex security investigation experience. Automation and development skills in Python, Go, or similar languages, with experience building production security tooling. Knowledg

Deine Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse befinden sich auf C1+-Niveau. Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten. Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus - Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen. Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt. Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt. Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents. Dein Extra-Boost - 29 Urlaubstage + je ein freier Tag an Heilig Abend & Silvester, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden. Vorsorge für deine Zukunft – Wir denken nicht nur nachhaltig, wenn es um Energie geht, sondern auch, wenn es um dich geht. Nutze unsere betriebliche Altersvorsorge und baue dir Schritt für Schritt ein solides Fundament für deine Zuku

jobs.description: About the role     At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, and the first AI agent marketplace for hospitality in our Agent Hub, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers.   We're looking for a senior Product Manager to own in our AI product domain. You'll turn our AI capabilities into coherent, commercially viable products that solve real operational problems for hoteliers. Your goal is to help hotels move towards genuinely autonomous operations, not to ship isolated automations or AI assistants.   This is not a backlog role. You'll take an ambiguous opportunity, find the right customer problems, define the proposition, build it with Engineering, bring it to market and drive adoption. You'll also play a central role in turning our AI capabilities into a meaningful and growing source of revenue.   This is a senior individual contributor role with real autonomy. You won't receive a roadmap and execute it. You'll shape it along our vision , using customer insight, data and sound reasoning. You'll work closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, and in close collaboration with our other value stream teams.     What you'll be up to   Productising and commercialising our AI capabilities . Define the proposition, target customers and use cases, and shape packaging and launch with commercial teams.   Building the foundations for AI across our ecosystem. Shape how our AI capabilities understand each hotel's context and work reliably with Apaleo and connected systems across operational areas.   Productising hospitality knowledge. Turn hospitality expertise and operational processes into scalable product experiences, with appropriate human oversight.   Driving autonomy and measurable value. Think in complete outcomes, such as staff hours saved and manual work removed. Show hoteliers tangible ROI.   Driving adoption. Run discovery, shape onboarding and usability, measure adoption and improve from real-world feedback.   Keeping AI products reliable and viable. Define good agent performance, understand cost and latency, set up evaluation and monitoring with Engineering, and trade off autonomy, reliability, human intervention and cost.   Owning strategy, roadmap and delivery in your scope , with clear specs, a definition of done and impact analysis.   Working with Engineering on trade-offs, dependencies, quality and our API-first AI-first architecture.   Balancing ambition with reality. Weigh the roadmap against operational requests, bugs and technical debt, and say no to good ideas that aren't great ones.   Spotting dependencies early with Hotel Operations and other engineering teams, since our AI capabilities build on the core platform.   Using AI in your own PM work and championing AI-assisted engineering.      What you'll bring   6+ years as a Product Manager, owning products from discovery through launch and adoption with limited day-to-day direction.   Proven zero-to-one experience. You've owned a revenue, adoption or retention number and can tell us what moved and what you killed, pivoted or repriced.   Commercial thinking. You've defined propositions, packaging and pricing, validated willingness to pay and worked with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success on go-to-market.   Systems and process thinking. jobs.description: Coding was first. Recruiting is next. We are building it. Metaview is an applied AI lab building AI coworkers for some of the world's most ambitious recruiting teams. It is software that can pursue a hiring objective, operate within real workflows, seek judgment at the right moment, and earn a customer's trust. We have one value: velocity. Not motion for its own sake, but real progress. We ship every day, ship on Fridays, and skip the tickets, roadmaps, and design-doc theater. Every builder on the team orchestrates a stack of agents, and we ship 8x what we did a year ago with the same small team. That pace needs a designer whose thinking keeps up: someone who can go from a vague problem to a clear, high-fidelity answer in hours, not sprints, and put it in front of engineers and customers while the idea is still hot. Process stays light, standards stay high, and feedback loops stay short. What you'll design Day to day, you'll own: the look and feel of new product experiences across the hiring workflow, from first sketch to final pixels interfaces that make AI agents feel transparent, trustworthy, and like a real coworker the moments where conversational signal becomes something a user can see, trust, and act on fast, high-fidelity prototypes that prove or kill an idea before anyone commits to building it the craft bar for the whole product: motion, density, hierarchy, and the details that make it feel inevitable What you'll own In your first 3–6 months, you should: own meaningful product areas end-to-end, from problem definition through rollout, in close partnership with engineering set how Metaview's AI products look, feel, and behave in real customer workflows turn messy, ambiguous problems into interfaces that feel obvious in hindsight raise the bar across craft, execution, and product judgment What we're after We're likely to be excited by people who: have designed and shipped beautiful, complex products in fast-moving software environments are deep specialists in product design: interaction, visual craft, and systems thinking at the highest level have a real point of view on products: what's great, what's broken, and what they'd change care about the pixels, the motion, and the details most people never notice like ownership, ambiguity, and working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, product, and customers want to help define what AI-native software feels like while the shape of the company is still being formed What you bring Helpful signals include experience with: designing products where the pixels matter: rich, interactive, information-dense interfaces design systems, real-time collaboration, or other hard interaction problems AI-native interfaces: agent interactions, streaming and loading states, the in-between moments of a conversation a portfolio that shows real obsession with craft, and the reasoning behind the decisions startup or scale-up environments where iteration speed and ownership are both high What you want to know — San Francisco A small, sharp, in-person team in San Francisco. Best ideas win on merit, not ceremony. Want to know what it's actually like? Read our unfiltered Slack at metaview.ai/careers#slackbook . We pay in the top 10% of the SF market: salary plus meaningful equity. Our process is fast and direct, and it's not unusual to hear back the same day. jobs.title: Graphic Designer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: ZEAL Network SE is a leading international provider of online lottery and prize draw products, operating for over 20 years with brands like LOTTO24 and Tipp24. As Germany’s largest digital lottery operator and a trusted partner of Spain’s ONCE, we are passionate about creating exciting and innovative ways for people to win. 7days Performance is one of the newest brands to join the ZEAL Group and a well-established name in the UK prize competition market. The brand gives customers the chance to win high-value prizes, with a strong focus on performance and luxury cars, alongside cash and other exciting prizes. Now part of ZEAL, 7days Performance is entering an exciting new chapter, combining its strong UK brand and community with ZEAL’s experience, technology and ambition for growth. It’s an exciting time to join the team and play a part in shaping what comes next for the brand. Location: Norwich-based, in office Monday - Friday (9am - 5pm) The role: We’re looking for a creative and organised Graphic Designer to join the 7days Performance content team. You’ll be responsible for producing engaging digital artwork across our competitions, website and marketing channels. This is a varied role covering everything from campaign graphics and paid ads to individual prize thumbnails and game themes. Your responsibilities Creating graphics for marketing campaigns and social media advertising. Designing main promotional artwork for new competitions. Producing instant-win prize thumbnails across cars, cash, technology and luxury products. Creating product thumbnails for raffle prizes. Developing visual themes and supporting assets for our Tap & Win games. Editing and retouching car, property and product photography. Resizing and adapting artwork for the website, email, social media and paid advertising. Maintaining a consistent standard and visual identity across all 7days Performance artwork. Managing multiple briefs and delivering work within agreed deadlines. Working closely with the content, paid media, email and wider marketing teams to deliver creative that meets the brief. Using AI image-generation and editing tools where appropriate to help create backgrounds, environments, concepts and creative variations. What you offer us: Previous experience in a graphic design or digital design role. A strong portfolio demonstrating digital and commercial design work. Strong Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator skills. A good understanding of typography, layout, colour and composition. Excellent attention to detail. The ability to manage several projects and deadlines at once. A collaborative attitude and willingness to respond to feedback. An understanding of social media and digital advertising would be beneficial. Experience using AI creative tools would be an advantage, although training can be provided. What we offer you: A modern, dynamic culture grounded in the success of a leading-edge e-commerce company. A talented team of ambitious, like-minded colleagues where your knowledge and ideas truly make an impact. Pension scheme with employer matching contributions of up to 7.5%. 25 days annual leave plus UK bank holidays. Enhanced sick pay after probation. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting. Role You will design the detailed mechanics of how users interact with A1 - the gestures, states, flows, and micro-decisions that determine whether an AI-driven product feels controlled or confusing. This role is focused on HCI interaction design: how users give input, receive feedback, supervise AI actions, correct mistakes, and maintain agency over AI-driven workflows. There are no established playbooks for interaction design in proactive AI products. You will help define new patterns from the ground up. What You'll Be Doing Design detailed interaction models for AI-driven flows, including how users initiate, monitor, pause, correct, and complete multi-step tasks. Define interaction states for AI interfaces: idle, thinking, acting, waiting, uncertain, interrupted, failed, and recovered. Design human-in-the-loop controls - how users review AI decisions, override actions, and stay informed without micromanaging. Create interaction patterns for delegation, approval, correction, escalation, reversibility, and recovery. Create detailed interaction specifications, annotated flows, and prototypes for engineering handoff. Work with product and ML teams to translate system capabilities and constraints into usable interaction patterns. Test interaction designs with real users to identify where AI behavior creates confusion, distrust, or friction. Contribute to a shared library of HCI interaction patterns that can be reused across the product. What You Will Need Experience as an interaction designer or senior UX designer with strong interaction design depth. jobs.title: Growth Product Manager - Customer Acquisition (German Speaking)
jobs.description: The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. Hybrid in Berlin or London We’re looking for a Growth Product Manager Own the systems that decide which German businesses iwoca reaches, and the journey they take from first click to submitted loan application. You’ll join a team that is still being built, with a data scientist in place and engineers being hired in parallel. A good fit if you like working from first principles, and would rather run an experiment than win an argument. The team The DE Acquisition Tech team builds the systems behind how German businesses discover iwoca and apply for funding: the models that decide which businesses to approach, the eligibility checks that tell a business early whether iwoca can help, and the signup flow itself. Product, analytics, data science and engineering sit in the same squad by design, so the team can go from hypothesis to shipped change without waiting on anyone else. The German marketing and sales teams depend on this work: the team’s models decide who they contact, and its journeys decide how many of those businesses convert. The team is being built right now. It currently includes a data scientist, and we’re hiring engineers in parallel – so you would join early enough to shape how the team operates. The role This role sits between iwoca’s German commercial teams – marketing, sales and commercial strategy – and the technical squad that builds for them. Reporting into the Head of Direct Acquisition, you will own acquisition and activation outcomes for the German market: finding the opportunities, defining the hypotheses, and working with engineering, data, marketing and sales to build, test and iterate. The scope is broad. We’re not looking for someone with deep expertise in every domain the team covers – spanning product development, analytics, UX and data science – but rather someone intellectually curious, and skilled at asking the right questions. Own the funnel from first visit to application Own every step of that journey, including the signup flow itself and the eligibility checks inside it. Set the roadmap for acquisition and the signup journey, and decide what the squad builds next. Own the scoring and segmentation that decides where marketing spends and who sales calls first. Build with your technical squad Ship lead scoring systems, eligibility checkers and signup flows with the team’s data scientist and the engineers we’re hiring. Rework website content, signup flows and decisioning logic with marketing and sales, to convert more of the businesses that already reach iwoca. Strip friction out of the signup journey, so that applying for funding takes minutes rather than an afternoon. Be the first call when the numbers look wrong Act as the technical partner for German marketing, sales and channel management on attribution, tracking and data pipeline problems. Investigate and resolve data quality issues – broken dashboards, misattributed traffic, unexplained volume changes – often at short notice. Give channel managers access to, and guidance on, the attribution logic behind their numbers. Keep the tracking and attribution systems trustworthy, so every decision downstream rests on numbers the team believes. Run the experiment

jobs.title: Diesel Mechanic
jobs.description: Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms. Job Overview We are currently seeking a skilled Diesel Mechanic to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining, repairing, and troubleshooting diesel engines and related systems on our autonomous surface vessels (ASVs) to ensure optimal performance and reliability. Responsibilities Perform routine maintenance tasks on diesel engines, including oil changes, filter replacements, and fluid checks, to ensure proper functioning and longevity. Diagnose and repair diesel engine malfunctions, mechanical issues, and electrical faults using diagnostic tools, technical manuals, and troubleshooting techniques. Inspect and test diesel engine components, systems, and subsystems to identify and address potential problems or areas of concern. Overhaul and rebuild diesel engines and associated systems, including fuel injection systems, turbochargers, and exhaust systems, as needed to restore performance and efficiency. Maintain accurate records of maintenance and repair activities, including parts used, labour hours, and service performed, to track equipment history and ensure compliance with maintenance schedules and regulatory requirements. Follow safety protocols and procedures for working with diesel engines and related equipment, including proper handling and disposal of hazardous materials and fluids. Collaborate with other maintenance technicians, engineers, and operators to troubleshoot complex problems, share technical knowledge, and implement effective solutions. Qualifications Marine Diesel and/or Volvo VODIA experience required GCSEs (or equivalent) are required. A recognised vocational qualification or apprenticeship in diesel mechanics, marine engineering, or a related discipline is preferred. Proven experience as a diesel technician or a diesel mechanic, with demonstrated proficiency in diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining diesel engines and related systems. Strong mechanical aptitude and technical skills, with the ability to read and interpret technical manuals, diagrams, and schematics. Familiarity with diagnostic tools and equipment used in diesel engine repair, such as scan tools, multimeters, and oscilloscopes. Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex mechanical and electrical issues. Effective communication skills and the ability to work independently or as part of a team. Willingness to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with changing priorities and deadlines. Ability to travel as needed to meet business objectives, including throughout the Indo-Pacific region and to our headquarters in Austin, Texas. This role will require spending 30+ days training at Saronic headquarters in Austin, Texas. Physical Demands Ability to perform physically demanding work for extended periods. Frequently and repetitively lift, push, and carry up to 23 kg's. Ability to work outdoors for extended periods in marine and waterside environments. Frequently and repetitively bend, lift, and reach to install and remove components of varying size and weight. Ability to stand and walk for extended periods, including over varied and uneven terrain such as docks, vessel decks, and gravel surfaces. Stoop, lay, bend, reach, squat, kneel, crouch, twist, and crawl for extended periods while working in confined or low-clearance spaces. Climb and maintain balance on ladders, platforms, vessels, and other elevated structures. Exposure to loud noise, vibration, engine exhaust, and hazardous materials with required adherence to safety and disposal procedures. Wear Personal Protective Equipment at all times in work areas, including safety glasses, gloves, hearing protection, steel-toed footwear, and other PPE as required. Benefits Stock Options: Equity options to give employees a stake in the comp

We are trusted advisors to, and thought partners with, startups to ensure that OpenAI’s technology is deployed safely and effectively, whilst also partnering with engineering, research, and product to turn those insights into evaluation systems, product improvements, and better model behavior. Presentations and community engagement are central to this role. You will engage developers and founders through technical talks, live demos, workshops, and programmes across the startup ecosystem, alongside targeted work with individual customers. Translate customer experiences and developer feedback into actionable insights for OpenAI’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams. You’ll thrive in this role if you: Have experience building at, founding, or working closely with early-stage startups, and understand the pace, ambiguity, and practical trade-offs involved. Combine developer empathy with sound technical judgment: you can uncover what a team needs, troubleshoot problems, and help them adopt effective, reliable workflows. Bring high agency, curiosity, and end-to-end ownership, working independently while collaborating closely with colleagues and ecosystem partners. jobs.description: 🪐 Discover our galaxy   Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:   - A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries - A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth - Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI - A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently   Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐   At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive. You will join Malt as a Customer Onboarding & Success Manager - Public Sector , based in Paris Manager Customer Success - Global, Public sector & SMB, you will work hand-in-hand and transversally with our Account Managers dedicated to the Public Sector.  Your main mission will be to ensure the smooth deployment and flawless execution of framework agreements ( accords-cadres ) and public tenders throughout their lifecycle. You will be the guarantor of compliance with public procedures and tracking commitments, acting as the primary operational point of contact for public beneficiaries and freelancers. Key responsibilities ✨ Onboarding & Pedagogy: Pitch platform benefits, lead training sessions, and perform product demos to drive user independence within ministries, local authorities, and public institutions. Public Tender Execution & Tracking: Anticipate the end of purchase orders or contracts, and provide proactive follow-ups to ensure business continuity and secure renewals (contract renewals, new market lots). Public Administrative & Budgetary Management: Pilot operational processes specific to the public sector (management and compliance of quotes/purchase orders, tracking Legal Commitments ( Engagements Juridiques ), validating activity reports/CRA for non-autonomous clients), and monitor budget consumption. Beneficiary Relations & Satisfaction: Act as the dedicated go-to person to centralize requests from public decision-makers and resolve operational incidents. Contractual Expertise (SLAs & CCAG): Master the specificities of technical/administrative specifications (CCTP, CCAP, CCAG) and service level agreements (SLAs) unique to each framework agreement to align our internal ways of working. Continuous Improvement: Identify operational pain points unique to public administrative processes and collaborate with Ops, Product, and Tech teams to automate and adapt our platform to public sector constraints. About you 🧑‍🚀 Experience: A previous public sector experience is mandatory for this job ! Solid background in managing complex client relationships, onboarding large accounts, or operational contract management Administrative Rigor: A keen sense of organization and familiarity with the inner workings of public administration (notions of public procurement, purchase orders, Chorus Pro, and budgetary validation workflows). Solution-Oriented: Excellent interpersonal skills, diplomacy, and the ability to resolve disputes or complex situations with a variety of stakeholders (from Procurement Directors to technical Project Managers). Tools & Data: Advanced proficiency in collaborative and analytical tools (Gsheet/Excel, Notion, Looker) and an appetite for AI applications. Languages: Native/fluent level of French (essential for dealing with the French administration) and professional level of English (as internal processes and the Malt team are international). How to join the mission? 🚀 First call with our Talent Acquisition team to better understand your background and aspirations (30-45 minutes). Interview with your future manager to delve into your experience and the specifics of the role

Join us and shape the future of finance in an inclusive, dynamic, and ambitious company. Be part of an adventure that is only beginning! About the Finance team The Corporate Finance team reports to the Finance Director. The Corporate Finance team oversees the financial reporting of Younited within a regulated banking environment. Its mission is (i) to deliver accurate accounting, tax, and regulatory reporting, (ii) provide reliable performance analyses to guide strategic decisions, partnering with business units to optimize resource allocation and support key growth initiatives, and (iii) drive the continued digital transformation of the overall finance function while working closely with teams across the company. The FP&A team is being reorganised into an end-to-end function of 4 people, including the Head of FP&A. Each FP&A controller owns both the forecast and the actuals on their scope, across the full management cycle — budget, business plan and capital plan, monthly closing anticipation, and post-closing analytics analytics. Context 📄 Reporting directly to the Finance Director, the Head of FP&A leads the newly structured FP&A function (a team of 3 FP&A controllers). He / She owns the management cycle and the calendar, arbitrates priorities and ad hoc requests, and acts as the guardian of the method and of the single planning model. He / She is accountable for the quality of the figures and for the development of the team. This role comes at a pivotal moment: Younited is moving to a market-standard, end-to-end FP&A organization and the Head of FP&A will be responsible for shaping his/her team target operating model, formalise scopes and ways of working, and progressively automate and strengthen the reliability of the whole planning and reporting chain — while partnering closely with the business to turn financial analysis into better decisions. Deliver timely, clear financial reporting tailored to each audience — leadership, local management and business partners — including management accounts, variance analyses and ad hoc studies, and act as a business partner to the divisions on strategic initiatives and performance improvement. jobs.title: Research Scientist – Foundation Models and Multimodal AI
jobs.description: About us Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed. Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity. K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners. Position is based in our Paris office or remotely in France, UK, Germany. Please submit your CV in English About the role: We are seeking a driven Research Scientist with hands-on expertise in Foundation Models (FMs) and Multimodal AI to help drive the next phase of our machine learning platform. In this role, you will bridge cutting-edge AI research and practical application. Rather than training massive base models from scratch, your focus will be on fine-tuning, adapting, and aligning open-weights foundation models across diverse data modalities (e.g. structured tabular data, single-cell scRNA-seq, image representations, and natural language) to build multimodal systems. In particular, you will be responsible for: Model adaptation and optimization: Adapt, fine-tune, and evaluate state-of-the-art open-source foundation models (e.g., domain-specific transformers, vision-language models) using fine-tuning and transfer learning strategies. Multimodal integration: Design and implement cross-modal alignment architectures (e.g., contrastive learning, projection heads, unified embedding spaces) to fuse structured, sequential, and text/image data layers. Pipeline and evaluation engineering: Build rigorous, domain-tailored benchmarking frameworks and evaluation pipelines to validate model reliability, generalization, and downstream task performance. Applied R&D collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams (data engineers, domain specialists, and software engineers) to integrate adapted models into scalable production and inference workflows. Low-hanging fruit innovation: Identify high-impact, incremental improvements in data pre-processing, embedding representation, and fine-tuning to maximize model performance without unnecessary computational overhead. About you Required qualifications / experience: Education: Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics or a related quantitative field. Experience: 2-4 years of post-degree experience applying deep learning and foundation models to complex datasets. Foundation models: Demonstrated experience adapting and fine-tuning foundation models. Multimodal learning: Proven experience with cross-modal representation learning, joint embedding alignment (e.g., CLIP-style architectures), or vision-language models. Technical stack: Advanced proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks ( PyTorch , Hugging Face ecosystem). Hands-on experience with fine-tuning techniques. Familiarity with data engineering tools for handling large-scale or multi-modal datasets (Parquet, AnnData, HDF5). Preferred qualifications/bonus: Experience working with biological or omics data (e.g., scRNA-seq, spatial transcriptomics, clinical and/or histology data). Experience deploying or scaling models using containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP). Track record of open-source contributions or peer-reviewed publications at top ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR) or domain-specific journals. #LI-HB1 What we offer Flexible work organization Friendly and informal working environment Opportunity to work with an international team with high technical and scientific backgrounds Recruitment Process & Security Please complete the form and submit your CV. About the Role As SAR Remote Sensing Engineer, you are the subject matter expert on applying advanced signal processing and machine learning to SAR data within our RF analytics team. You own the analytics layer end to end: algorithm design, real-time implementation and field validation on real captures from our own platforms. You will also shape the move toward multi-modal solutions that combine SAR with optical and RF sensor feeds. Cycles are measured in months, and the scope grows with the company. Responsibilities Lead initiatives using SAR polarimetry and coherence for automated change detection. Design and prototype state-of-the-art machine learning models for SAR image segmentation. Develop algorithms for target detection and object classification on SAR data. Fuse SAR with optical, RF and other data sources to support GNSS-denied operations. Port algorithms from Python prototypes to real-time pipelines with software and embedded/FPGA teams. Build the capture, labelling and replay tooling that makes performance claims reproducible. Work with radar, radio, electronic warfare and computer vision teams to define what the analytics layer needs from each sensor. Candidate Requirements Master’s or PhD in electrical engineering, telecommunications engineering, signal processing, applied mathematics or a related field. 3+ years of experience in radar signal processing or SAR remote sensing. Theoretical and practical expertise in machine learning, both deep learning and classical techniques. Experience taking at least one algorithm from prototype to real hardware running on real signals. Train from Deployment Logs: Utilize our massive repository of offline, classical stack data to pre-train robust robot foundation models. Drive the Software Feedback Loop: Translate core research needs into concrete infra capabilities, track experiments, analyze results, and close the loop directly with ML researchers to unblock model progress Real-World Evaluation & Operations Design Physical Benchmarks: Design new robotic tasks and build lightweight physical setups to systematically evaluate model capabilities far beyond the limits of simulation. Close the Physical Feedback Loop: Analyze real-world evaluation results to guide the ML research direction. You will identify operational bottlenecks across software, hardware, and deployment systems to continuously improve our iteration speed. jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. The opportunity Our engineering teams build a product that enterprises run their purchase-to-pay and order-to-cash processes on every day. Much of the product knowledge behind it sits with our founders and domain experts. As we grow, we are moving from a project-oriented model, where features come top-down and success is measured by output, to a product-oriented one: empowered teams that own problems end-to-end and are measured by their impact on customers and the business. As Head of Product, you lead that shift. You build the product management practice for the BLP Platform from an early stage. Our first product managers are joining stream-aligned teams, starting with Invoice and Procurement, and the team will grow to 4–5 PMs as we expand. You hire them, coach them, and set the standard for what great product work looks like at BLP. You report to the CTO and work closely with Engineering, Projects, Sales, and our founders. What you’ll do Build and lead the product management practice for the BLP Platform: hire, coach, and develop a team of product managers as we scale. Move the product organization from an output-driven model to an outcome-driven one. Establish the product management craft at BLP: discovery practices, evidence-based decision making, and a clear standard for what “good” looks like in the role. Transfer product knowledge out of the experts’ heads and into the teams, without losing the domain depth that got us here. Build the direct line between our teams and our customers. Make our data usable for product decisions. We have BigQuery, PostHog, and prediction-rate analytics available, and we want product managers who reach for them by default. Shape how the product organization works as we grow: intake, prioritization, roadmapping, and the operating rhythm. Contribute directly to product strategy for the platform. What you bring 10+ years in product management, including experience leading or formally coaching product managers, with a real point of view on how product people are developed. Experience working in an empowered product model, where teams were assigned problems to solve rather than features to build. A track record of shipping enterprise B2B software that customers actually adopted. jobs.description: Functie  Reliability engineer   Beschrijving functie   De reliability engineer is een productie specialist die de totale levensduur van installatie bestudeert en analyseert hoe het bedrijf omgaat met investeringen en onderhoud van assets.  De reliability engineer is de expert in het identificeren van potentiële risico’s en het voorkomen van stilstanden. Daar problemen moeilijk volledig te voorkomen zijn, geeft de reliability engineer adviezen hoe te handelen bij storingen die plaatsvinden. Het doel is te voorkomen dat fouten in productiesystemen optreden.   De reliability engineer analyseert tevens de veiligheidsrisico’s geassocieerd met installatie fouten. Ter voorkoming van stilstand maakt de reliability engineer onderhoudsschema’s en analyseert statistische gegevens die helpen te voorspellen wanneer en hoe fouten voor kunnen komen. De reliability engineer ontwikkelt inspectie criteria die gebruikt worden om de asset health te monitoren.  Om dit te kunnen bereiken maakt de reliability engineer gebruik van een aantal technieken.   Voorlopige gevaren analyse: Preliminary hazard analysis is de initiële identificatie van potentiële gevaren en fouten in een productie proces of systeem Failure modes and effect analysis ( FMEA): Betreft het opsommen van de manieren dat een proces of systeem kan falen en wat de consequenties hiervan zijn. Criticality analysis: bepaalt hoe ernstig de consequenties zijn van een asset fout voor het productiesysteem van het bedrijf. Onderhoudbaarheid: gedetailleerde informatie hoe efficiënt en betrouwbaar het bedrijf een onderdeel kan repareren. Foutenboom analyse: onderzoek van een systeem fout door naar de kleinere voorafgaande gebeurtenissen te kijken die hebben bijgedragen aan de systeem fout Taken Trouble shooting Faciliteren van root cause analyse in geval van complexe, multidisciplinaire afwijkingen/storingen waar de uitvoerende teams niet uitkomen Daily problem solving Continue verbeteren Periodieke analyse op performance killers en cost drivers om van daaruit middels verbetervoorstellen bij te dragen aan een maximale beschikbaarheid & betrouwbaarheid van installaties tegen minimale kosten Innovatief denken m.b.t. het verlagen van de kosten en verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid Leiden/faciliteren van verbeterteams c.q. verbeterprojecten Change Management Beoordelen van wijzigingen op technische haalbaarheid met het bestaande machinepark. At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products.     Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters   At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas:  Physical/embedded device security.  OT (operational technology) network security.  OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications.  Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines.   What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments.  As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives.
