jobs.description: <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">RDQ427R369</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business.</span></p> <p>Our Developer Ecosystem organisation shapes how developers and the AI agents working for them build on the Databricks Data and AI Platform, from within the product to the tools they already use.</p> <p>We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead our declarative deployment framework, which turns data and AI projects into versioned, reviewable, repeatable software. It is one product with two entry points. Third-party developers use our open-source CLI from their IDEs, terminals, and CI/CD systems. First-party, they author, deploy and inspect the same projects inside the Databricks workspace. In both, AI agents increasingly do the work: coding agents drive the CLI, and our in-product AI assistant authors and deploys projects alongside the developer. Thousands of organisations run their CI/CD on it, and it is one of the fastest-growing parts of the platform.</p> <p>The team owns the deployment engine and CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and the metadata service and deployment history that record every deployment. The hard problems are real infrastructure-as-code problems: reconciling declared and live state, making plans safe for humans and agents to approve, keeping visual authoring and code in sync, and shipping weekly releases that remain backwards-compatible for our largest customers.</p> <p><strong>The impact you will have:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and grow the team:</strong> Manage a team of senior engineers across three closely connected areas (the deployment engine and open-source CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and deployment history and metadata), working with strong tech leads. Hire, coach and promote, and grow engineers into tech leads.</li> <li><strong>Make agentic development the default path:</strong> Shape how developers and AI agents author, validate and deploy projects, both inside the workspace and from the developer's own coding agent. Design the tools, skills and guardrails so agents get the same safety and auditability as humans.</li> <li><strong>Own the strategy and roadmap:</strong> Partner with Product and Design to set a multi-quarter roadmap for declarative deployment: agentic development, governed deployments and deployment history, enterprise CI/CD, and new resource coverage. Make the trade-offs explicit when the demand is larger than the team.</li> <li><strong>Raise the bar on execution and operational excellence:</strong> Run a predictable delivery process for a fast-moving, open-source product with frequent releases. Own reliability, on-call health, incident response and the quality bar for a tool customers depend on to ship to production.</li> <li><strong>Treat backward compatibility as a product feature:</strong> Lead engine and configuration migrations without forcing customers through a flag day, and communicate change clearly to customers, the community and field teams.</li> <li><strong>Lead across the platform:</strong> Drive alignment with the many platform teams whose resources and services the framework deploys, and with our sibling teams in Developer Ecosystem (SDKs, CLI, IaC provider, IDE). Zo draag je niet alleen bij aan de ontwikkeling van jonge professionals, maar ook aan de toekomstige personeelsbezetting en talentontwikkeling van Passenger Services! Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Instroom en introductie: Je brengt de behoefte aan stagiairs en de beschikbare begeleidingscapaciteit in kaart. Je voert sollicitatiegesprekken, stemt de selectie en plaatsing af met Recruitment en leidinggevenden en coördineert de introductie, trainingen en stageafspraken. Begeleiding en ontwikkeling: Je stelt samen met stagiairs en onderwijsinstellingen leerdoelen op, voert regelmatig voortgangsgesprekken en coacht stagiairs tijdens hun stage. Ook organiseer je tussentijdse evaluaties en eindevaluaties en beoordeel je stageopdrachten en eindverslagen. Relatiebeheer en samenwerking: Je onderhoudt contacten met onderwijsinstellingen, bespreekt stagevoorwaarden en evaluatiemomenten en onderzoekt mogelijkheden om het netwerk van dnata uit te breiden. Daarnaast vertegenwoordig je dnata op stagebeurzen en open dagen. Talentontwikkeling en doorstroom: Je volgt de stage-ervaring en toekomstwensen van stagiairs, signaleert mogelijke uitval en onderzoekt de redenen voor voortijdig vertrek. Je adviseert Duty Managers en Recruitment over geschikte kandidaten voor een dienstverband en coördineert de overdracht na afloop van de stage. Monitoring en verbetering: Je houdt gegevens bij over instroom, lopende stages, afronding, uitval en doorstroom. Je rapporteert over de voortgang en begeleidingscapaciteit, signaleert knelpunten en doet voorstellen om het stageproces continu te verbeteren. Wat breng je mee? Vereisten: Mbo 4 werk- en denkniveau. Een relevante opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in luchtvaartdienstverlening, personeelsmanagement of begeleiding en coaching. Ervaring met het begeleiden en coachen van stagiairs of medewerkers binnen Aviation. Ervaring met het voeren van sollicitatie-, voortgangs- en beoordelingsgesprekken. Je beschikt over goede coachingsvaardigheden en weet anderen te motiveren in hun ontwikkeling. Kennis van stageprocessen, leerdoelen en de samenwerking met onderwijsinstellingen. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid en weet op een consequente en rechtvaardige manier richting te geven. Goede mondelinge en schriftelijke beheersing van zowel het Nederlands als het Engels. Wat bieden wij? Een marktconform salaris, passend bij jouw ervaring en conform de CAO WPBL. Eventuele onregelmatigheidstoeslagen volgens de CAO WPBL. 25 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantiegeld. Reiskostenvergoeding conform de CAO WLVA, gratis busvervoer en parkeermogelijkheden. Een goede pensioenregeling, waarbij dnata bijdraagt aan jouw pensioeno

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description: Security Engineer - Maatwerk Software met Impact Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij. Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details. Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Security Engineer . Iemand die veel energie krijgt van het opbouwen van een nieuw technisch securitydomein. Een gedreven specialist die graag zelf de regie neemt over de inrichting van moderne tooling en veilige architectuur. Jouw rol Als Security Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor de technische beveiliging van onze infrastructuur, interne werkplekken en cloudomgevingen. Je bouwt het securitydomein verder uit en selecteert de juiste tooling voor Dawn. Je beheert de gekozen systemen en richt deze tot in de puntjes in. Daarbij vertaal je complexe techniek naar een gedegen en onderbouwd advies voor verschillende afdelingen. Je vormt hiermee de verbindende brug tussen tech leads, hostingteams en Interne IT. Beleid en compliance pakt het ISO-team op, zo kun jij je volledig op de techniek focussen. Wat je zal gaan doen: Je werkt mee aan en verbetert centrale security-tooling zoals EDR en SIEM. Je werkt hands-on aan kwetsbaarhedenbeheer, actieve detectie, monitoring en het ontwerpen van hardening-standaarden. Je adviseert tech leads en hostingteams over veilige architectuur en helpt hen bij security-initiatieven. Je fungeert als het vaste technische aanspreekpunt voor het SOC en beoordeelt samen escalaties. Je draait mee in de technische analyse bij incidenten en bewaart de rust binnen het crisisteam. Wie ben jij? Je hebt een hbo-denkniveau en bij voorkeur een achtergrond in Cyber Security of Informatica . Je brengt een stevige basis mee in security engineering of infrastructuurbeveiliging. Je bezit hands-on ervaring met moderne security controls, IAM, secure configuration en kwetsbaarhedenmanagement. Kennis van cloudomgevingen zoals AWS en affiniteit met netwerkarchitectuur is een grote pré. Je bent zeer leergierig naar nieuwe technieken en toetst gemaakte keuzes altijd scherp en kritisch. Je zoekt actief de verbinding met collega's om samen de beveiliging naar een hoger niveau te brengen. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels en bent bereid om (hybride) te werken op onze kantoren in Geldermalsen en Hilversum. Wat bieden wij jou? Autonomie : Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie. Maatschappelijke Impact : Je beveiligt cruciale systemen voor Dawn Technology en haar klanten. Salaris : Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4.500,- en €6.000,- passend bij jouw ervaring. Vakantiedagen : 25 vakantiedagen om volop te ontspannen. Werkplek & Sfeer : Gezellige werksfeer, flexibele werktijden, hybride werken en verzorgde lunch op kantoor (verschillende locaties maar je bent voornamelijk te vinden in Geldermalsen en Hilversum). Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken : Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding en een fiscaal fietsplan. Pensioen : Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen. Ontwikkeling & Extra's : Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen. Events & Fun : Toffe (lokale) teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events. jobs.title: Product Owner Werkplek & Support (Detachering / ZZP)
jobs.description: Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren.  Wie ben jij Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen.   Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten.   Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn.   Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale werkplek. Denk ook aan randapparatuur, lokale ondersteuning en supportdienstverlening. Je hoeft niet zelf de technisch specialist te zijn. Wel begrijp je moderne werkplekdienstverlening voldoende om een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn voor engineers, architecten, securityspecialisten en leveranciers.   Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is de operationele samenwerking met onze externe servicedesk en andere leveranciers. Samen met het team geef je richting aan prioriteiten en verbeteringen en zorg je dat ontwikkelingen binnen Werkplek & Support goed aansluiten op de ondersteuning van onze medewerkers. Je voelt je daarnaast thuis in een omgeving die verandert. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen, kunt omgaan met weerstand en neemt stakeholders mee wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat. Wat ga je doen Wat breng je mee? Voor ons is niet je exacte functietitel of het aantal jaren ervaring doorslaggevend. We willen vooral zien dat je dit soort verantwoordelijkheid eerder succesvol hebt gedragen. •    Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bepalen van visie, roadmap en prioriteiten voor een IT-product of IT- dienst;    Je kunt verschillende belangen afwegen en duidelijke besluiten nemen en onderbouwen; •    Je kunt vanuit een Product Owner-rol richting en focus geven aan een team zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn; •    Je bent sterk in stakeholder- en relatiemanagement en krijgt engineers, gebruikers, management en leveranciers mee; •    Je hebt ervaring met externe IT-dienstverleners en weet in operationele samenwerking, samen met het team, verbeteringen te realiseren; •    Je begrijpt werkplekdienstverlening en IT om inhoudelijk een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn; •    Je hebt ervaring met het verbeteren van dienstverlening en kunt sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid en klantbeleving; •    Je kunt omgaan met weerstand, bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie stellen en koers houden wanneer nog niet alles duidelijk is; •    Je beschikt over hbo/wo-werk- en denkniveau. Ervaring met Microsoft 365 is welkom, maar diepgaande technische expertise is niet noodzakelijk. Ervaring met grotere transities of het insourcen van IT-dienstverlening is een pré. Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support ben je verantwoordelijk voor de visie, roadmap en priori

jobs.title: Senior R&D Engineer/Projectleider Flight Test and Certification (m/v/x)
jobs.description: Ben jij op zoek naar een  uitdagende baan  in de wereld van de lucht- en ruimtevaart? En.....ben je die R&D engineer die helpt civiele en militaire vliegtuigen veilig, duurzaam en competitief te laten vliegen? Door aan vliegtuigen te meten en te testen om alles te weten te komen?  Wil jij jezelf verder ontwikkelen en word je enthousiast van techniek, innovatie, veiligheid en duurzaamheid? Dan spreken we je graag! Wat ga je doen? Als Senior R&D engineer Flight Test en Certificatie werk je mee aan het veiliger, duurzamer en competitiever maken van de militaire en civiele luchtvaart. Je werkt aan vliegtuigen, helikopters en onbemande vliegende systemen. Om onze binnen- en buitenlandse opdrachtgevers te ondersteunen in het bereiken van hun doelen voer je testen uit en analyseert de resultaten, je toetst wijzigingen aan vliegtuigen aan de regelgeving in het kader van veilig vliegen en je ontwikkelt nieuwe regelgeving om innovatieve technieken te implementeren. Je bedenkt en werkt aan innovatieve oplossingen samen met collega’s en andere R&D instituten in een (inter-) nationale setting. Je leidt projecten, hebt veel klantcontact (intern en extern) en werkt met zelfsturende teams, in wisselende samenstelling. Je voert projectwerk uit, je coördineert werkpakketten en je initieert met je collega’s nieuwe projecten. Het werken bij Koninklijke NLR kenmerkt zich door variatie en dynamische werkverbanden. Onze missie is om nieuwe technologie praktisch en veilig toepasbaar te maken en daarmee de Nederlandse (en Europese) industrie en overheid te helpen om voorop te lopen. We geven goed onderbouwde adviezen aan beleidsbepalers, ontwikkelaars en gebruikers. Wat breng je mee? Afgeronde WO master in een technische richting zoals luchtvaarttechniek, elektrotechniek of informatica; Tenminste 5 jaren relevante werkervaring; Ontwikkeling van lucht- en ruimtevaarttuigen en klimaat neutrale luchtvaart spreken je aan als werkgebieden; De ambitie om expert te worden op het gebied van flight test en certificatie; Affiniteit met werken voor Defensie, en liefst kennis van de Defensie organisatie; Bewezen capaciteiten als projectleider voor grote projecten; In staat zijn om klantenwensen te vertalen en een brug te slaan tussen techniek en operationele impact; Positieve instelling, initiatiefrijk, flexibel, resultaatgericht; Communicatief vaardig in het Nederlands en Engels (tenminste op C1 niveau) Wat bieden wij jou? Bij NLR krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken én jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je werkt in een innovatieve nationale en internationale hightech omgeving waar nieuwsgierigheid, samenwerking en vakmanschap centraal staan. We geloven dat mensen het beste presteren als ze de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, zich te blijven ontwikkelen en een gezonde balans te vinden tussen werk en privé. Verder bieden wij jou onder anderen: 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek); 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%; De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer; Een zorgtoelage van €145,- bruto (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA, als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten; Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof; Volop kansen om te blijven leren met opleidingen, trainingen, coaching en andere ontwikkelmogelijkheden; De mogelijkheid om 32-40 uur per week te werken inclusief thuiswerken. Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving De afdeling Flight Test en Certificatie (ASTC) richt zich op het ondersteunen van de Nederlandse overheid (Defensie, EZK, IenW) en markt waarin thema’s als "bescherming van de samenleving" en “Klimaat neutrale luchtvaart” belangrijke uitgangspunten zijn. We voeren experimenten en vliegproeven uit met onze eigen vliegtuigen, geschaalde vliegtuigen en drones. We ondersteunen vliegproeven met vliegtuigen van klanten. Dit kan zijn voor een onderzoek

jobs.title: Integration Test Engineer
jobs.description: Role - Integration Test Engineer Company - iwell - Harmonizing Clean Energy Location - Utrecht About iwell At iwell, we are all about reinforcing energy security. We help European businesses become more energy independent. With growing regulations, extreme price volatility and rising grid issues, they need to be resilient. It is time to take charge and think ahead. We deliver energy management solutions that ensure that businesses are always in control of their energy. Our in-house developed EMS and modular battery storage drive profit through sustainability, making businesses future-proof.  We are a fast-growing international team of driven and collaborative talents, from engineers and software developers to creative thinkers and customer-focused business developers. No matter what your strong suit is, we always are looking for people who are determined to make a positive impact: iwell is committed to form a diverse and inclusive team to tackle the challenges of the energy transition.    The Role The proof is in the pudding, they say in the UK, however, we believe proof is in the test data. All our systems and their interactions within the larger energy ecosystem are thoroughly tested. We are serving a diverse customer base with strict demands, our services power business and key infrastructure. We demand that our products are subjected to a wide range of testing during the integration and development phase. We're seeking a talented and curious test engineer with a passion for sustainability and battery energy storage.  You will handle a wide variety of topics from different customer requirements and have a lot of freedom to develop the test methodology and strategy. You will work within the battery system team, where software and hardware come together in the products we develop for our customers.  We will rely on your experience, hands-on approach and judgment. You will be crucial in driving our mission of transitioning from fossil-fuel dependence. If you're passionate about sustainability and have the technical skills to bring our vision to life, we want to hear from you. What you will do Develop test campaigns based on internal and external requirements Discuss and present test results internally and externally Execute tests and document the result Support the integration of hardware components into iwell’s BESS, ensuring compatibility and performance. Develop and maintain technical documentation, such as system specifications,  processes, and instructions. You will become one of the practical system experts within iwell, interacting with field service, product development and engineering teams. What are looking for Degree in Electrical Engineering (HBO/WO) or equivalent experience. Experience in electrical design of high power and energy conversion systems. Knowledge of technical standards and grid operator connection requirements. Able to make the basic design for a site with energy production and storage, feeding into the Medium Voltage AC grid, including cable system design, PE system design and according to national installation guidelines. Strong communication skills and attention to quality assurance Ability to read and produce technical drawings and schematics Ability to speak and write German is a plus Note: at iwell, we value growth potential over perfection. Feel free to respond if you can see yourself meeting this list in the (near) future. What we offer A competitive salary within the range of EUR 5,200 - 5,800 (plus 8% holiday allowance) 30 holidays per year, plus an annual company trip of 3 days The opportunity to do volunteer work, by offering 1 volunteer day per year Learning & Development budget of EUR 1,500 per year  Attractive pension plan with Brand New Day  Working remotely for 2 weeks per year  We cover your travel costs, regardless of whether you come by bike, car, or public transport. A mobile phone allowance of EUR 25 per month Additional activitie

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: About the role At ClickHouse, we believe in making product decisions grounded in data, not gut feelings. To support that, we've built a comprehensive internal data warehouse — read more about it on our blog . It powers analytics, forecasting, and decision-making across every team in the company. Our stack centers on ClickHouse as the core storage and processing engine, complemented by dbt , Airflow , S3 , AWS , Superset , and GitHub Actions . We ingest data from 30+ distinct external sources, process over 2.5 PB of data, and deliver most data marts to business consumers with a 1-hour end-to-end latency - a standard that demands highly optimized, rock-solid transformation pipelines. We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help evolve the DWH platform, push its technical boundaries, and deliver reliable, high-performance data models to business users across the organization. Key Responsibilities DWH Platform Development Design and develop reusable Airflow components - operators, connectors, and hooks - along with custom integrations tailored to our data architecture. Build reusable dbt macros and abstractions: incremental strategies, ETL building blocks, and generic data quality tests, all optimized for ClickHouse-specific behavior and our data patterns. Develop DataOps tooling - CI pipelines, data migration frameworks, and security controls - with a strong focus on reliability, self-service usability, and scale. Team contributions Conduct thorough code reviews for team members and other team contributors. Actively participate in technical and architectural design discussions. Drive technical leadership in specific areas of our stack. Continuously improve the team's development environment, with a focus on automation - including AI-assisted workflows. Contribute to platform stability through proactive troubleshooting and timely incident resolution. Data modeling Develop, refactor, and optimize business data models in line with our modeling standards and ClickHouse best practices. Mentor and support contributors through code reviews and technical guidance. Lead the design and implementation of the most technically demanding data marts - particularly those involving high data velocity, large volumes, or complex business logic. Qualifications Required: Exceptional SQL skills - this is non-negotiable. Strong hands-on experience with Airflow , dbt , and Python . Proven track record building and optimizing large-scale, high-throughput data pipelines. Solid understanding of data warehousing fundamentals: ETL/ELT, dimensional modeling, and data quality. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field. Comfortable thriving in a fast-paced startup environment — exciting and dynamic, but sometimes wonderfully chaotic. Preferred: Hands-on experience with ClickHouse - a significant advantage. Familiarity with AWS or other cloud platforms. Experience with CI/CD development, especially using GitHub Actions . Perks Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries. Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity. Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee. Learn more about our values here . Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse. jobs.title: Senior Cloud Engineer - Product Metrics (EMEA Remote)
jobs.description: About the team The Product Metrics team owns the collection, storage, and serving of metrics collected from customers' ClickHouse instances. jobs.title: Senior Partnership Manager Germany
jobs.description: Help build fair, engaged and high-performing teams. We believe everyone deserves a fair opportunity to develop and be rewarded for the value they bring. That's why we build software that helps organizations set clear expectations, define what a role entails, assess performance fairly, support employee growth and make compensation transparent and explainable. From clear roles to fair rewards, all within one continuous process.  We do this with a driven team of 55+ colleagues. Hundreds of companies in the Netherlands, from scale-ups to corporates, already use Learned. Now we're taking the next step: Germany .  As Senior Partnership Manager Germany you're part of our founding DE team. You build the partner channel from scratch and become the face of Learned in the German HR ecosystem. Lay the foundation for our partner channel in Germany You build our German partner channel from the ground up. You decide how we do partnerships in Germany, and then you make it happen: from the first partner to a network that brings in a steady flow of new business. Our network has two parts: Implementation partners: HR consultants and advisory firms that bring Learned to their clients. Learning partners: companies specialized in job evaluation and learning & development. What you’ll do Set the strategy. Map the German HR ecosystem and decide which partners to focus on first. Set clear targets for the channel and make sure partners and direct sales strengthen each other. Build the foundation. Shape the partner model for Germany: partner tiers, the commercial terms, and the playbook and processes that let the channel grow. Our Dutch partner programme is your starting point. You adapt it to the German market. Find and close new partners. Start conversations at board level, then negotiate and close partnerships. Turn partners into growth. Onboard and enable partners, build joint plans and turn them into a steady source of new business. Activate the market. Put Learned on the map in Germany with partner and customer events, such as roundtables, webinars and breakfast sessions. You work together with marketing and get operational support for running them. How your time is split (at the start) ~50%: Finding new partners ~30%: Partner management ~10%: Events and activation ~10%: Strategy As the network grows, your focus shifts towards partner management and scaling the channel. You might also build a team around it. Who you work with You report to our Partnership Lead in NL and work closely with our Founding Account Executive Germany.. Where you'll work You choose one of two setups: Based in or around Düsseldorf or Cologne. You work remotely in North Rhine-Westphalia, close to your partners and visit our office in Utrecht regularly. We plan to open an office in Düsseldorf or Cologne, and you'll help build it. Based in or around Utrecht (NL). You work from our office in Utrecht and travel to the NRW region about twice a month for a few days . Either way, you start with an onboarding at our office in Utrecht. jobs.description: Operations & Strategy Manager Permanent employee · Full-time · Berlin (HQ) Our mission for you European energy costs are twice as high as in the US and China, and electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. This puts European industry under massive cost pressure – and companies need to act now. trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that brings together energy procurement, energy management and the marketing of flexible assets in one product. This helps companies save up to 30% on their recurring electricity costs while switching to renewable energy. We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast – the market window is open and we intend to own it. Now we are looking for an Operations & Strategy Manager to own a business-critical part of our energy value chain: the processes behind how we configure, price and quote long-term energy products for our customers. About trawa trawa is a tech-driven scale-up based in Berlin with around 100 employees, combining deep energy market expertise with in-house software development. We've raised over €35M to date, most recently a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic and Tiny VC. This role is based in our Berlin office, where we work together in person most of the week. We offer flexible working hours, so you can shape your day in a way that works for you. The Team You'll join our Energy & Trading team, which owns the energy side of our business – from sourcing and portfolio management to making sure our customers' energy products work in practice. You'll report directly to our Energy & Trading Manager and work closely with the COO, our Trading Team, Sales, Pricing, Product and Tech. You start without direct reports, but with a clear mandate: own our CPQ process end-to-end and grow the margin it generates. Who we are looking for Strong quantitative skills: You think analytically, feel at home with numbers and data and can confidently challenge quantitative results – without having to be a quant or developer yourself. Ideally, you have a degree in a quantitative or business field (e.g. economics, engineering, industrial engineering, business administration). Business acumen & process mindset: You think commercially, care about margins and unit economics, enjoy turning messy processes into robust, scalable ones and prioritise by impact. Experience with commercial processes such as pricing or deal desks, in energy, financial services or any other industry, is a plus. Interest in energy markets: You are fascinated by how energy markets work – from wholesale and forward markets to PPAs, hedging and pricing – and want to dive deep into them. Entscheidend ist, wie tief du in die Arbeit eingestiegen bist und welche Verantwortung du dir jetzt zutraust. Deine analytischen Grundlagen sitzen. Du bringst sorgfältiges Arbeiten aus dem Transaktionsumfeld in ein Startup ein und gestaltest mit, wie wir arbeiten. jobs.description: Company Overview Mindpeak is a Hamburg-based AI company on a mission to make cancer diagnosis more accurate, efficient and personalized. We build deep-learning solutions for computational pathology that bring AI directly into clinical practice. Our technology is already used in routine diagnostics across more than 25 countries and supports leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies in developing and advancing new cancer treatments. What makes Mindpeak special is the combination of disciplines required to make this work. Software engineers and machine learning experts work alongside pathologists, scientists, product specialists and commercial teams to turn cutting-edge AI into products that deliver real value in healthcare. This also makes building our team unusually interesting. Many of the people we hire sit at the intersection of different disciplines and are difficult to find through conventional recruiting. Identifying exceptional talent, understanding what great looks like and building hiring processes that allow us to make consistently strong decisions are therefore critical to Mindpeak’s next stage of growth. The Role We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Manager to take ownership of recruiting across Mindpeak. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who genuinely enjoys recruiting and sees Talent Acquisition itself as their profession. You will recruit across different functions, with a particular focus on senior, business-critical and hard-to-fill roles spanning Product, Technology and Business. You will work closely with our founders and hiring managers to define what we actually need, identify what great looks like for each role and translate this into rigorous, efficient hiring processes. This is a hands-on recruiting role, not a generalist People & Culture or Organizational Development position. You will personally run critical searches, source candidates, conduct interviews and close hires. At the same time, we expect you to help raise the quality of hiring across Mindpeak by challenging unclear requirements, improving interview practices and bringing structure and discipline to how we make hiring decisions. You will not inherit a recruiting team, but you will have the mandate and budget to work with external recruiters and specialist search partners where they add value. Your Mission Own the full recruiting cycle : from search strategy, sourcing and screening through interviews, offers and closing. Partner with our CEO and hiring managers as a trusted talent advisor : clarify requirements, challenge assumptionsand drive decisions forward. Proactively identify and engage high-quality candidates , particularly for senior, leadership and hard-to-fill roles. Run high-quality interviews that go beyond CVs and polished answers, uncovering concrete evidence of impact, decision-making and individual contribution. Select, brief and actively manage external recruiters and search partners where they add value. Keep pipelines, bottlenecks and risks transparent for leadership, and keep improving how Mindpeak hires without unnecessary bureaucracy. What Success Looks Like Priority searches run with clear role profiles and explicit assessment criteria, even when requirements start out ambiguous. You successfully engage high-quality passive candidates and build genuine interest in Mindpeak and our roles. Interviews across Mindpeak become more rigorous and consistent , based on evidence rather than titles or impressions. Most importantly, critical roles get closed with people who raise the quality of the organisation. Your Experience Substantial hands-on experience owning full-cycle recruiting; a background in executive search or another environment with a strong sourcing and assessment culture is a plus. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Intern
jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth. About the role Learn how a global trading business really works, and build the AI tools that make it faster. As a Forward Deployed Intern, you spend six months inside our business. You sit with the teams that buy, sell and move industrial materials, learn how their work really happens, and build tools that make it faster, with AI at the core. You work alongside our product and engineering team, with a mentor who reviews your work and helps you grow. This is not a shadowing internship: you take on real problems, ship real tools, and see them used every day. What you will do Learn the business Join our sales, procurement, logistics and finance teams and understand how a trade works from request to delivery. Spot where people lose time to manual work. Build , Measure & Share Build automations, small agents, scripts and dashboards with AI tools such as Claude. Ship first versions quickly and improve them with feedback from the people who use them. Track whether what you built saves time or prevents mistakes. Decide with your mentor what to improve and what to stop. Document what you built so others can use it. Show your work in demos to the team. What success looks like Several tools or automations in daily use by our teams Measured time savings for at least one team Clear documentation others can build on A solid understanding of how a global trade works end to end What you bring You are enrolled in a degree in computer science, engineering, business informatics or a similar field. You can code, for example in Python or JavaScript, and use AI tools in your daily work. Real curiosity about how businesses work, not only about technology. You communicate clearly and like working with people from other backgrounds. You can commit to six months full-time in Berlin. Fluent English. German is a plus. jobs.description: About Jimdo We exist to unleash the power of the self-employed - helping solopreneurs and micro-businesses thrive by doing what they're passionate about and removing the complexity of building lasting, successful businesses. Jimdo started in 2007 when three school friends built a website builder in a Northern German farmhouse to help everyone build a presence online. Today, we're a profitable, remote-first company with 220+ people from 50+ nationalities working across 15+ countries. We've helped build over 36 million websites to get online across the world. We're more than just a website builder. We're an AI-powered platform that helps self-employed people actually run and build successful businesses — from getting found online, winning customers and running their business with a peace of mind by knowing exactly what to do next to move forward. At the heart of Jimdo is a strong belief in personalized, data-driven guidance. Our platform combines design, business tools, and an AI-powered core that turns real customer data into clear insights and next steps helping our customers focus on what moves their business forward. Role Overview At Jimdo, we think the best support is the one a customer never needs. When our customers, self-employed people and small business owners, do need help, it should come fast: from self-service and AI first, and from a person when that's what the case needs. We're bringing our support tooling, Zendesk, chatbots and AI work together into one team with one backlog and one roadmap. As Senior Product Owner, you'll lead that team and own the outcome: more questions answered by AI, faster help, lower cost to serve, and customers who still trust us. You'll also shape where this goes next. Over the next couple of years AI will handle more and more first-line support, and you'll decide how the work is split between AI and people, and build the platform around it. The team and who you'll work with You'll report to the Head of Customer Support Services and join CSS, our support organisation. You'll lead a small team of Zendesk and AI specialists and work day to day with the engineers who build our support tools. You'll work closely with our knowledge and readiness team, support agents and team leads, product teams, our Company AI team, Data & Analytics, and our support and AI vendors. What you'll be doing: Set the vision for our support platform and AI with the Head of CSS, and turn it into a roadmap, a business case and results. Lead, coach and grow your team, and bring specialists and engineers together around one backlog and clear quarterly outcomes. Own how well our chatbot, Zendesk AI agents and Copilot perform: define what a good AI answer is, measure it, and switch off what doesn't help customers. Improve routing, user identification and self-service entry points so customers get to the right answer faster. Spend real time with customers and support agents: read tickets, listen to chats, see where people get stuck. Build a written case for every bigger piece of work, own the cost to serve, and check results against your forecast. Turn what you learn in support into evidence that helps product teams fix problems at the source. Your first months After 3 months: your team works from one backlog and one outcome roadmap, and the quality bar for AI answers is agreed. After 6 months: you've delivered and reported your first quarterly outcome, including how AI resolution compares with your forecast. What you bring to the table 5+ years as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally including support, CX, service or internal platform products. You've shipped AI or chatbot features in production and can name the metric you moved, the baseline and the result. You explain product decisions in commercial terms: cost, savings, effect, and what you learned when a forecast was wrong. You've managed people and led people who didn't report to you, ideally across departments. You do your own analysis with SQL or BI too

Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. You will also work with external collaborators and suppliers to develop the designs, equipment, systems and materials that will enable Proxima’s mission to deliver clean, sustainable fusion energy. jobs.description: <p>P-1127</p> <p>At Databricks, we are obsessed with enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems, from security threat detection to cancer drug development. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform, so our customers can focus on the high value challenges that are central to their own missions.</p> <p>Our engineering teams build highly technical products that fulfill real, important needs in the world. We develop and operate one of the largest scale software platforms. The fleet consists of millions of virtual machines, generating terabytes of logs and processing exabytes of data per day. At our scale, we regularly observe cloud hardware, network, and operating system faults, and our software must gracefully shield our customers from any of the above.</p> <p>The Delta DML team owns the core write-path operations for Delta Lake, the open-source storage layer behind the Databricks Lakehouse. Our mission is to deliver industry-leading performance and a seamless user experience at massive scale, with most data written in Databricks flowing through our platform.&nbsp; We drive performance innovations like Low Shuffle Merge and Deletion Vectors and actively contribute to open source efforts to unify Delta and Iceberg formats.</p> <p>We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Staff Software Engineer to join our backend team. In this role, you will be instrumental in designing, developing, and maintaining robust backend systems that power Databricks workspaces. You will build the next-generation platform for serving workspace assets, ensuring high QPS, low latency, reliable, and performant systems, proactively addressing the future growth challenges. Additionally, as a senior member of the team, you will provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior engineers, contributing to the overall improvement of team coding practices and system designs.</p> <p><strong>The Impact you will have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Solve real business needs at large scale by applying your software engineering.</li> <li>Low level systems debugging, performance measurement, and optimization on large production clusters.</li> <li>Build architecture design, influence product roadmap, and take ownership and responsibility over new projects.</li> <li>Introduce tools to allow greater automation and operability of services.</li> <li>Use your deep experience to help prevent and investigate production issues.</li> <li>Plan and lead complicated technical projects that work with several teams within the company.</li> <li>Contribute as a technical team lead by mentoring others, lead sprint planning, delegating work and assignments to team members and participate in project planning.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we look for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>15+ years industry experience building and supporting large-scale distributed systems.</li> <li>Comfortable working towards a multi-year vision with incremental deliverables.</li> <li>Motivated by delivering customer value and impact.</li> <li>Strong foundation in algorithms and data structures and their real-world use cases.</li> <li>Experience driving company initiatives towards customer satisfaction.</li> <li>BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or related majors, or equivalent experience.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. jobs.description: At SiteMinder, we believe our success comes from our people. We build diverse, inclusive teams where different voices, backgrounds and perspectives are valued. Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000+ hotels in 150+ countries, connects to 3,000+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion+ in hotel revenue each year. That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still. About the Account Executive role... Are you ready to take the next step in your SaaS Sales career? Do you want to be part of the technology shaping the future of the travel industry? Join our international, dynamic and outgoing team in Germany! You will become a trusted advisor to hotel owners, building awareness about how our products can benefit their property. You will have the chance to learn about the challenges that accommodation providers face, and offer a solution that will bring value to their day-to-day and bottom line. Joining SiteMinder as the leader in dynamic hotel revenue management, you will be at the forefront of innovation in the sector. jobs.title: Industrial Data & Solutions Engineer (gn) @ Stealth AI Venture, Berlin
jobs.description: This is an Atlantic portfolio company. What we're building Factories run on machines that generate huge amounts of data, and almost none of it gets used. We're changing that. Our two founders both held C-level roles at leading German robotics ventures. They have spent years bringing advanced technology onto real shop floors, and now they're hiring the founding core team. Your role & responsibility You're the person who makes our product work in the real world. You go into a plant, figure out what's actually broken, connect the data, and stay until operators use the product every day without being asked. You'll work with everyone from the machine operator to the plant manager, and with IT and OT. You own each customer from the first conversation through rollout and expansion. Berlin or home-based in Germany, with regular time in Berlin with the team. You'll spend about 20% of your time at customer sites. What you'll do Own deployments end to end: use-case definition, data onboarding, validation, rollout, training, and adoption Turn messy production problems into clear data, analytics, and solution requirements Onboard and validate machine, process, quality, and maintenance data from industrial systems Spot data problems that only make sense if you understand the machine behind them Build and validate KPIs, features, anomaly signals, calibration methods, and analytical workflows in Python and SQL, using statistics and time-series analysis Run the project with the customer and our commercial lead: plans, workshops, validation sessions, and success criteria Find the next machine, line, data source, or use case, and expand with it Bring what you learn in the field back to the product, so each deployment makes the platform better Help write the playbook for how we deliver, as the customer engineering team grows You might be a fit if you Have worked hands-on with industrial machines and production processes, in manufacturing, automation, maintenance, quality, industrial engineering, or industrial data Know your way around PLCs, SCADA, MES, historians, production databases, quality systems, or OPC UA Use Python and SQL to answer questions, not just to write code Have worked with time-series data, KPIs, anomaly detection, or root-cause analysis Communicate as well on the shop floor as in the plant manager's office Like solving hard problems in automation and process engineering Take ownership, work independently, and are comfortable when things are ambiguous Are happy to travel to customer sites and have a driver's license Speak fluent German and English A degree is optional. jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Engineer
jobs.description: About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the Engineering team At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. By combining deep technical expertise with creativity, the team pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in insurance technology. Within engineering, our product teams are cross-functional, pairing frontend and backend engineers with designers and product managers. This enables end-to-end ownership of features, with engineers contributing across design, architecture, implementation, and testing. Collaboration is a core part of how we work, ensuring that every release is both technically sound and valuable to our users. How we work We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder , and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work. We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods , usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart. We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move. Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest. A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your stronges

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Integrated MarComms, France & Benelux
jobs.description: Tinder exists to help people meet, connect and create a spark. After 13 years of leadership in the dating industry, culture is what keeps that mission relevant to each new generation of daters. Product is central to this shift. Every new feature is a chance to tell a human story about how people connect, and culture is where those stories land. To make that shift real, we’re bringing our Tinder MarComms regional EMEA strategy together: one unified in-country team in each key market and one regional structure. Communications now sits within Marketing, so both work toward the same KPIs and growth objectives. The Integrated MarComms role is where culture meets brand relevance, with one holistic objective: driving MAU growth. Social Media is the true D2C MarComms engine for Tinder, and creator and influencer led activations play a central role in driving registrations, reactivations and cultural relevance. The regional MarComms team owns the full paid, earned and owned media cycle across key markets. The Integrated MarComms Senior Manager leads the earned and influence dimension of that ecosystem, with a strong influence on owned social channels and brand partnership storytelling. The role reports to the Director of Marketing of France & Benelux. It works in a matrix with the Snr. Director of Social Media, Snr. Manager of Brand Partnerships, and closely with the Global Comms team.   Key Responsibilities 1. Creator & Influencer Ecosystem Engagement Build and nurture a diverse network of community voices: creators, influencers, podcast hosts, cultural commentators and community leaders. Develop collaborations rooted in a strong audience insight and shared creative idea, giving partners a meaningful role beyond content distribution. Work closely with social, influence and brand partnership teams to connect local opportunities with broader brand priorities. Create opportunities for audiences to participate and share their own stories, turning campaigns into conversations that extend beyond launch. 2. Social-First Integrated MarComms Strategy Translate market priorities into integrated MarComms plans for France & Benelux, in close partnership with the market lead, marketing manager and EMEA teams. Develop compelling creative ideas with the potential to travel across paid, owned and earned channels, giving each channel a clear role in building relevance, consideration and action. Build strategies around how Gen Z discovers, shares and participates in culture, across various formats, creators, podcasts, digital communities and emerging platforms. Help raise the creative and strategic standard of Tinder’s organic social channels, building distinctive formats and stories that audiences want to be part of. 3. Creating Cultural Narratives for Gen Z Turn audience insights, cultural tensions and dating behaviours into locally relevant narratives that strengthen Tinder’s role in modern dating, particularly among young women. Make product innovation meaningful through human stories and creative experiences that show how Tinder helps people meet, connect and create a spark. Broaden the representation of dating success to reflect the connections, experiences and stories Gen Z values, building a more positive and credible perception of Tinder. Anticipate cultural moments and emerging conversations, using data, cultural understanding and creative judgment to identify where the brand can make a meaningful contribution. Own a quarterly and annual activation calendar, balancing planned campaigns with timely opportunities, and contribute local insights and ideas to EMEA initiatives. 4. Earned Impact & Measurement Connect MarComms activity to clear objectives, supporting registrations and reactivations as contributions to the overarching goal of MAU growth. Own measurement of earned and social impact, including share of conversation, message uptake, sentiment and meaningful engagement, moving beyond coverage volume and impressions. P

jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-doctoral researcher (12 months) Mathematics of energy-efficient AI: diffusion models on emerging hardware
jobs.description: The question Generating one image with a diffusion model means evaluating a large neural network tens to hundreds of times. That repetition is where the energy goes, and it is part of why data-centre demand is now visible at grid scale: the Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory puts US data-centre electricity use at 176 TWh in 2023, 4.4 % of national consumption, a figure that more than doubled since 2017 largely because of AI servers, and projects 325–580 TWh by 2028. Emerging hardware attacks exactly this primitive: analog in-memory computing, silicon photonics, ferroelectric devices and stochastic computing perform the underlying matrix–vector products at lower energy than digital CMOS, under conditions on scale and precision, but return a perturbed result. The usual objection is that nobody can say in advance how much perturbation a model tolerates. In EMMA, this opportunity is pursued through a PCM-based photonic matrix–vector engine as the primary demonstrator, complemented where appropriate by FeFET-based analog computing, so that device-level non-idealities are treated as explicit design parameters rather than as after-the-fact implementation losses. Diffusion models are an unusual case in which that question has a mathematical answer: their convergence theory bounds the discrepancy between the generated and target distributions by three terms, of which only one, the L 2 error of the learned score, depends on the hardware. That side is now in good shape: for stochastic samplers, bounds linear in the dimension under minimal assumptions on the data; for deterministic samplers, a matching theory under regularity. What is missing is the bridge. The theory is parameterised by a score error, the hardware literature by conductance noise, effective number of bits and photons per multiply–accumulate; nobody has written the map between them, in either direction. The quantisation literature for diffusion models reports image-quality scores; the induced L 2 score error, in the form the convergence theory needs, is directly measurable and goes unreported. One open sub-question sets the direction: the distinction between an error redrawn at each evaluation, as in stochastic computing, and an error frozen at write time, as in deterministic quantisation, has been settled in one setting only, and not the one hardware lives in; carrying it over is what this position exists to do. The work is judged on one concrete outcome. For at least one architecture, we want to show that theenergy gain from moving the score evaluation off digital CMOS is real, measured where it survives integration and not extrapolated from a single tile, and that it is paid for by a loss in sample quality that is small and, above all, tunable: a knob the designer sets, whose position the theory predicts rather than discovers afterwards. What you will do The work is organised in four packages, summarised below; the full research programme is available from the supervisors on request. 1. Make the score error measurable, starting from Gaussian targets where the whole error decomposition is closed-form. You will report the induced score error for a given perturbation of the network’s arithmetic, the number the theory needs and the quantisation literature does not report. 2. Map device physics onto the theory. Propagate the published error models for the technologies INL works on through the score network into an explicit score-error budget, separating what is proved from what is measured. 3. Extend the guarantees. Existing bounds assume a deterministic oracle, or a benign randomised one; extend them to error that is part frozen at write time and part redrawn at each call, and settle, on the way, which process the score error should be controlled along. 4. Co-design with INL, and deliver the proof of concept. Turn the score-error budget into an energy– accuracy frontier for INL’s PCM-based photonic matrix–vector engine, using device-calibrated circuitlevel models; a FeFE

jobs.title: Founding Data Researcher
jobs.description: TL;DR Davis is hiring a Founding Data Researcher to build the data behind our foundation model, trained from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. You will own the data end to end, from raw floorplans and synthetic generation to a canonical representation, curation, large-scale pretraining and the ablations that tell us which data actually moves the model. Here the dataset is part of the algorithm. About Davis Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis. We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability. We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital , with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end. The Role You will own the data our foundation model learns from, a model we train from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. Part of the corpus comes from real floorplans as images and PDFs that have to become clean, standardized graphs. A large part will be synthetic, procedurally generated building graphs, geometry and rendered floorplans, with controlled variation in style, scan noise, annotations and furniture, each kept with its ground-truth graph automatically. You will think about the whole loop, from raw and synthetic data to a canonical structured representation, curation and validation, the training dataset, large-scale pretraining, evaluation, data ablations, and back to improving the generator and the data mixture. You are senior enough to architect the data stack and set the data strategy, and hands-on enough to write the pipelines, run the experiments, train the models and do the ablations yourself. What you will be working on Corpus from raw sources. Turn real floorplans (images, PDFs, scans) into clean, standardized building graphs, with the geometry and semantics that make them trainable. Synthetic data generation. Explore strategies to expand the dataset with synthetic data. Canonical representation and curation. Define the standardized representation, then filter, deduplicate, quality-score and validate at scale, with versioning, provenance and lineage. Pretraining data and mixtures. Assemble the training datasets, design the mixture and the curriculum, and blend synthetic and real data for large-scale pretraining. Data ablations. Train models to learn which data actually helps, read the results, and feed them back into the generator and the mixture. Evaluation. Build the eval harness (datasets, metrics, regression tests, monitoring) that tracks data and model quality over time. What We Are Looking For You have built the dataset, not just trained on it. You have personally built or generated the data used for a large pretraining run, from raw or synthetic sources, rather than only training on a dataset someone handed you. Senior and deeply hands-on. At least 5 years of strong experience, senior enough to architect the data stack and set strategy, but still coding the pipelines, running the experiments and doing the ablations yourself. Data as a first-class problem. A track record where the data itself is the object: curation, filtering, deduplication, quality scoring, mixtures, synthetic generation. Strong engineering. Deep Python, clean and typed code, async and concurrency, distributed data pipelines, TDD culture.

Shape technical decisions: Work closely with our engineering leadership to translate product requirements into thoughtful architectural solutions, balancing immediate needs with long-term scalability. jobs.title: Product Manager, Device Data Management (Français/Anglais)
jobs.description: Product Manager, Device Data Management (Français/Anglais) Lieu : Paris, France (hybride, trois jours par semaine au bureau) Niveau : Senior Product Manager Équipe : Device Data Management (DDM) Contrat : CDI À noter : ce poste est basé en France. Vous devez donc y résider ou être prêt·e à déménager, et disposer déjà du droit de travailler dans l’UE. Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de sponsoring de visa, mais nous l’examinons poste par poste : gardez un œil sur notre site carrières pour les opportunités à venir. Un français et un anglais courants (à l’oral comme à l’écrit) sont indispensables, et nous vous demandons de soumettre votre CV en anglais . À propos de Kaluza Kaluza est la plateforme d’Energy Intelligence qui transforme la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les acteurs de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié. Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel à travers les foyers, les appareils, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie quotidienne. Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des innovateurs comme Volvo et Volkswagen. Ce que vous ferez : Vous serez responsable de la localisation française de Device Data Management (DDM), l’un des domaines produit clés de la plateforme Kaluza. DDM consomme des flux de données internes et externes pour représenter les fournitures, compteurs, registres, relevés et consommations. Il gère aussi les parcours liés à ces entités (par exemple, la mise à jour de la configuration d’un compteur), les API qui exposent les données, les pages front-end qui les présentent aux utilisateurs, ainsi que les calculs de projection et d’extrapolation de consommation. C’est un rôle produit full-stack et très opérationnel : vous interviendrez sur tout le domaine, du modèle de données jusqu’à ce que voient les utilisateurs à l’écran. Traduire les exigences du marché français en spécifications claires : transformer les règles du marché de l’énergie français (Enedis, GRDF, passerelle GRD, règles sur les données de compteurs et d’équipements) en exigences produit détaillées couvrant la conformité réglementaire, les flux de données des équipements et la qualité des données. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec nos clients : collaborer main dans la main avec ENGIE et les futurs clients du marché français pour comprendre leurs besoins et construire les exigences ensemble. Bâtir une relation de confiance telle qu’ils viennent vous voir en premier, et vous appuyer sur cette proximité pour orienter ce que DDM construira ensuite pour la France. Construire, pas seulement spécifier : passer vous-même de l’idée au prototype fonctionnel en interrogeant les données, en esquissant des contrats d’API et en montant des preuves de concept. Nous attendons de vous que vous utilisiez quotidiennement des outils d’IA (ex. Claude Code) comme multiplicateur pour prototyper, investiguer et débloquer des situations, et pas seulement pour rédiger des documents. jobs.title: Head of Hospitals & Home Care
jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Doctolib est une entreprise B Corp engagée à construire ensemble la santé dont nous rêvons tous. Avec 2 900 collaborateurs en France, en Allemagne, en Italie et aux Pays-Bas, nous accompagnons plus de 420 000 professionnels de santé et 90 millions de patients, transformant l'accès aux soins et la prise en charge à travers l'Europe. Nous accélérons désormais notre ambition : devenir le partenaire clinique de référence en Europe, de confiance pour les patients et les professionnels, grâce à la puissance de technologies avancées et de l'IA. Notre ambition est de construire le système d'exploitation clinique de demain pour l'Europe - offrant des résultats de santé mesurables pour des millions de personnes. Pour les professionnels de santé : Nous réduisons la charge administrative, augmentons la prise de décision clinique grâce à l'IA et permettons de nouveaux modèles de soins. Pour les patients : Nous passons de soins réactifs en cas de maladie à une gestion proactive de leur santé, en donnant aux personnes les moyens de prendre en charge leur santé avec des compagnons numériques de confiance, recommandés par les médecins. Vos missions L'hôpital est clé pour le développement de Doctolib. En une décennie, nous avons construit une présence solide auprès des établissements de santé, publics et privés à but non lucratif, avec une suite complète de solutions couvrant l'ensemble du parcours ambulatoire : visibilité de l'offre de soins, planification, prise de rendez-vous, préparation administrative, assistant de consultation IA, téléconsultation, téléexpertise et bien plus encore. En tant que Head of Hospitals & Home Care, vous prenez la tête d'une équipe d'une quinzaine de personnes, structurée en acquisition et account management, et appuyée par de nombreuses équipes expertes partenaires, notamment Déploiement, Interopérabilité, Product Marketing et Affaires Publiques. Vous êtes le ou la garant(e) de la performance commerciale, de la satisfaction client et de la vision stratégique du segment hospitalier en France, tout en ouvrant la voie à de nouveaux territoires : le médico-social et les soins à domicile. Votre responsabilité sera de combiner performance à court terme, développement de la base installée et construction d'une vision stratégique à deux ou trois ans pour le segment. Vous rejoindrez l'équipe Salaried & Retail France de Doctolib, en reportant à Maric Philibert, notre VP Sales, Salaried & Retail. Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à : Piloter et atteindre les objectifs de net MRR du segment, sur l'acquisition, l'expansion et la rétention, avec une implication personnelle dans le développement des comptes les plus stratégiques et l'accélération du cross-sell sur les nouvelles solutions, notamment l'Assistant de Consultation et la Téléexpertise. Assurer la satisfaction et l'usage effectif des solutions Doctolib dans les établissements clients, en coordination étroite avec les équipes Déploiement, Interopérabilité et Customer Care. Manager, développer et engager une équipe d'environ 15 personnes, accompagner sa montée en séniorité et renforcer son efficacité grâce à la donnée et aux agents IA. Construire et incarner la vision stratégique à deux ou trois ans du segment, en lien avec la Product Vision de Doctolib et les tendances de marché, en coordination avec les équipes Product Marketing, Affaires Publiques, Communication et Produit. Développer et entretenir les relations institutionnelles clés et piloter les partenariats stratégiques du segment. Explorer et engager Doctolib dans les segments médico-social et soins à domicile, en définissant les besoins, la stratégie et les approches tactiques adaptées. Développer une approche structurée de segmentation, d'account planning et de couverture des comptes stratégiques, afin d'augmenter l'adoption, l'expansion, le cross-sell et la rétention. Coordonner les équipes Tech, Déploiement, Legal, Finance, Product Marketing, Affaires Pub

Met jouw technische expertise neem je verantwoordelijkheid voor complexe elektrotechnische ontwerpen, adviseer je opdrachtgevers en deel je jouw kennis met collega’s.   De uitdaging   Als Senior Electrical Engineer ben je onderdeel van de Unit Real Estate en werk je aan het elektrotechnisch ontwerp binnen uitdagende projecten in de onderwijs-, onderzoeks- en cultuursector. Van nieuwbouw en renovatie tot complexe transformatievraagstukken: jij vertaalt de wensen en eisen van de opdrachtgever naar slimme, duurzame en technisch hoogwaardige oplossingen. Je werkt binnen multidisciplinaire projectteams nauw samen met collega’s vanuit onder andere werktuigbouwkunde, bouwfysica en duurzaamheid. Vanuit jouw ervaring overzie je de samenhang tussen verschillende disciplines, denk je mee over conceptuele keuzes en neem je verantwoordelijkheid voor de technische kwaliteit van het elektrotechnisch ontwerp. Je bent daarnaast een inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt binnen projecten. Je adviseert opdrachtgevers en projectteams, begeleidt minder ervaren engineers en draagt actief bij aan het delen en verder ontwikkelen van kennis binnen Deerns.   Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren:  Je ontwikkelt zelfstandig elektrotechnische concepten en ontwerpen voor complexe gebouwen. Je ontwerpt installaties op het gebied van onder andere energievoorziening, verlichting, sterk- en zwakstroom, data, communicatie en beveiliging. Je maakt complexe technische berekeningen en beoordeelt berekeningen en ontwerpen van collega-engineers. Je voert zelfstandig technisch overleg met opdrachtgevers, architecten, uitvoerende partijen en andere betrokken stakeholders. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit en voortgang van jouw werkzaamheden en signaleert tijdig afwijkingen in planning, kwaliteit of budget. Je stelt technische rapportages, bestekken en andere ontwerpdocumenten op en controleert deze. Je begeleidt en coacht minder ervaren engineers binnen projecten en helpt hen zich inhoudelijk verder te ontwikkelen. Je signaleert kansen binnen projecten, denkt mee over aanvullende dienstverlening en levert waar nodig een bijdrage aan offertes en klantgesprekken. Je volgt ontwikkelingen en innovaties binnen het vakgebied en deelt jouw kennis actief met collega’s.   Het team   Je komt te werken in een hecht team van jong tot oud. Dit team is onderdeel van de Unit Real Estate, die in totaal uit circa 40 collega’s bestaat.Samen werken we aan nieuwbouw-, renovatie- en transformatievraagstukken voor overheden, bedrijven en instellingen van uiteenlopende schaalgrootte. Geen project is hetzelfde. Daarbij werken we veel samen met andere disciplines en expertisegroepen binnen Deerns, zowel in Nederland als daarbuiten. Juist van integrale en technisch complexe vraagstukken worden wij enthousiast. Als Senior Electrical Engineer speel je hierin een belangrijke inhoudelijke rol. Met jouw ervaring help je niet alleen projecten verder, maar draag je ook bij aan de ontwikkeling van collega’s en het team   Dit ben jij   Je bent een ervaren engineer die technische diepgang combineert met een praktische en oplossingsgerichte instelling. Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt tegelijkertijd actief de samenwerking met collega’s en andere disciplines. Je bent in staat om complexe technische vraagstukken te doorgronden, keuzes goed te onderbouwen en deze helder over te brengen aan opdrachtgevers en projectteams.
